question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus token-budget helper exports as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold token budgeting into the broader assemble metadata RFC #82137?
rationale: The PR changes public plugin API and SDK exports that third-party context engines may depend on, while a broader assemble metadata design remains unsettled.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
options.body: Approve this focused optional API once generated docs/API artifacts, redacted live proof, and review blockers are resolved.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token budgeting together with the broader assemble metadata contract.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Remove the SDK helper exports and defer public helper exposure until the plugin API shape is maintainer-owned.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
recommendation.body: Approve this focused optional API once generated docs/API artifacts, redacted live proof, and review blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the strongest recent merged history on the context-engine budget path affected by this decision.
